testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/checkout/verify-bundle-product-details-for-retail-user.spec.ts > Webstore - Checkout > verify bundle product details for retail user

scenario.summary: A registered retail user signs in, adds a bundle product (picking its 'Mobile' swatch, qty 5), checks the bundle's child rows and name in the order summary, selects Custom Flat Rate shipping, removes the account's auto-applied voucher, applies a voucher (Amount To Be Paid math), checks invalid voucher and coupon messages, applies a valid coupon (order-total math), pays with Vantiv Express, checks the receipt and logs out.
steps: Sign in with the dedicated retail account (username/password from the test data).
Search the bundle SKU, click the variantAlt swatch, set quantity 5, add to cart, open the cart.

Proceed to checkout: bundle child rows of bundleChildParentSku contain bundleChildren; productNameLink(productId) equals productName; select Ship Complete + Custom Flat Rate; remove the auto-applied voucher.
Apply voucherNumber: voucher row number, Voucher Amount / Amount To Be Paid labels, order total - voucher = amount to be paid; remove the voucher.
Apply an invalid voucher and an invalid coupon: error messages.
Apply the coupon: success message, discount visible, Handling Charges, order-total math.
Fill project name and additional information, pay with Vantiv Express, check the receipt (thank-you banner, job name = projectName), log out.
stateChanges: Registered user's cart filled with the bundle
A new order is placed for the user, paid by card (Vantiv Express), with the coupon; one coupon redemption is used
assertions: Bundle child rows contain "z-1234602 - GE 6' Extension Cord" and "z-1234603 - GE 9' Extension Cord"
Voucher row equals voucherNumber; Voucher Amount / Amount To Be Paid labels; |order total - voucher - to be paid| <= 0.05
Coupon success message; discount visible; Handling Charges label; order-total math within 0.05
Thank-you banner visible; receipt job name equals projectName; Sign In heading after logout
evidence: Title and the five step labels match the flow.
Credentials (masked) name the existing registered user: USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED with preferred.required true (credential source).

Missing output: bundleChildren ('<child sku> - <child name>') are derived from the bundle's child products; PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK returns no child SKUs or names.
variantAlt (the swatch the test clicks) is in the spec's schema but not in the scan values; DOUBT: a bundle with a 'Mobile' swatch is unusual - PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK does not constrain swatches.

coupon TESTCHECKOUT (promotion Testim_CheckoutPageCoupon): tda rows shows an Amount Off Order coupon of store MaxwellsHardware (PortalId 7), discount 10, order minimum 10, coupon required, allowed with other coupons, no profile; mapped to COUPON_AMOUNT_OFF_ORDER (collection, creates a fresh coupon per run; output couponCode). If the page shows the promotion message, this assertion depends on the coupon data. The approved cart coupon entries (ORDER15, message 'Coupon Applied Successfully', asserted 'Coupon applied successfully.') suggest the page shows a fixed resource string instead.

Re-mapped (voucher keys 2026-11-01): voucherNumber EAY2PSKU9S -> need voucher (VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER), output voucherNumber, preferred (the test's own voucher first); read-only: applied and removed, no order placed with it

Ownership gap: the voucher must be the one restricted to the declared account. A declared account (preferred required) cannot be linked to (validator), so VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER has no user param: the test's own voucher is tried first (preferred, bound to this account in the data); a fallback voucher is restricted to SOME customer, not necessarily this one. Enforcing it needs the planned core feature 'record owned by the declared account' (as for saved carts and reorder)
